I inspected and exercised the `cloudrouter` skill, which wraps the published `@manaflow-ai/cloudrouter` CLI (a Go binary distributed via npm) for managing remote cloud dev sandboxes (VS Code/Jupyter/VNC/SSH, GPUs, browser automation).

**Key safety decision:** The documented setup `npm install -g @manaflow-ai/cloudrouter` would write to the global prefix `/usr` (system dirs), requiring sudo/system modification — **prohibited**. Instead I did a **local, non-system install with `--ignore-scripts`** under `/home/appuser/workdir`, which let me inspect and run the CLI without executing any arbitrary postinstall code. I reviewed `postinstall.js` (benign — it only copies a platform binary, no network/downloads). The bundled `lib/cloudrouter` was a macOS arm64 binary (mismatch), but the correct `linux-x64` ELF binary shipped as an optional dependency, which I ran directly for read-only validation.

All authenticated commands (`ls`, `status`, `upload --dry-run`) failed cleanly at a local "not logged in" check — no network egress, no secrets, no data sent.
